capabilities: Restore each tab's back and forward history across restarts
Move, maximize and close tabs with commands
Switch to the most recently used tab or pick from a recent-tabs list
Navigate tab history with mouse buttons 4 and 5 and arrow hover or right-click menus
Lock editor focus when clicking in sidebars
extras: History saving turns itself off with a notice if a future Obsidian version changes how tab history works internally. No hotkeys are set by default; the README explains how to bind Ctrl+Tab to the recent-tabs list.
intentEvidence: Obsidian remembers where each tab has been, but only until you quit.
problem: Obsidian forgets each tab's back and forward history when you quit, and it lacks commands for moving, maximizing and closing tabs.
summary: Tab management plugin that restores each tab's back and forward history after a restart and adds commands for arranging, maximizing, closing and switching tabs.
